full_judgment: 3. Respondent Nos.1-3 contested the prayer for temporary injunction by filing written objections refuting the claim of the plaintiff-petitioner claiming that Islami Bank Bangladesh Limited; the respondent No. 2 got a decree in Artha Rin Suit Nos. 29 of 2005 and 5, 6 of 2005 against Capital Ship Breakers Limited, the petitioner's vendor in respect of the suit property. In execution of the said decree, the suit property was sold in auction. A sale certificate was issued in his favour and thereupon, the Artha Rin Adalat executed and registered a sale deed on 23rd August, 2009 in his lavour and also delivered possession to him.
